henry.title: A Postcard to Dad in Scotland
henry.intro: Write a postcard to Dad in Scotland. (About 15 minutes.)
links: Bonus: VisitScotland castles (pictures for the front)
Look at pictures to get drawing ideas.
worksheet:
Dear Dad,
This week I ____________________.
I learned that ____________________.
Dad, did you see ____________________?
I miss you.
Love, ____________
Draw the front of your postcard:
Check: ☐ Capital letters  ☐ Periods  ☐ 3 Scotland words

passage.text: 💌 A postcard has a greeting, a few sentences, and a goodbye. Example: Dear Dad, This week I played a drone. Did you see a wee sheep? I miss you. Love, Henry

henry.challenge: Add a 5th sentence with a describing word, like 'bonnie' or 'crunchy'.
